title: The packet receipt types gain optional authored-generation sections, and the packet line helpers are shared
summary: @inventarch/runtime exports from the package root the HostHookDeclaration, PacketDefinition, OperationDefinition, HarnessDefinition and RegistrationRow types. PacketReceipt gains four optional sections: generated (identity, word agent-profile, playbook or hook, path and SHA-256 of each generated file), definitions (PacketDefinition rows, a union of {word: 'operation', definition: OperationDefinition} and {word: 'harness', definition: HarnessDefinition}), hooks (HostHookDeclaration rows: identity, event PreToolUse, the edit tools, the path selections and the message) and unsupported (identity, word agent-profile, playbook or hook, and reason); HostOutput gains an optional hooks. The ./internal/packet-host subpath also exports inline, code and prose, the line folding, code span and IA-word code span helpers the entry file is written with. Limits: renderHost fills none of the new sections and its output, the packet and its digest are unchanged; a receipt without them still reads, and nothing writes them until the projection writer applies the generated set; ownership stays the projection state, not the receipt.
